facts.fact: The World Bank diagnostic states that civil registration is still paper based, and that a digital civil registration system supported by Portuguese Cooperation is still in the conceptualization phase; undated, the published date is used.
The World Bank diagnostic states that civil registration is still paper based and names a lack of digitalization among its constraints; undated, the published date is used.

The World Bank states that the civil registration system is under the Ministry of Justice, with services provided by 55 Civil Registration Offices (conservatories and decentralized posts) and 20 hospitals and health centers; undated, the published date is used.
The World Bank states that a holistic assessment of the CRVS system under APAI-CRVS in 2017 resulted in the approval of a national strategic plan and the creation of a steering committee.

The World Bank counts 55 Civil Registration Offices plus 20 hospitals and health centers providing registration, gives no number entering digitally, and cites lack of power and connectivity at CRVS centers; undated, the published date is used.
